title: Eduardo J. Echeverria
name: Eduardo J. Echeverria
html: Eduardo J. Echeverria (PhD, Free University in Amsterdam; S.T.L., University of St. Thomas Aquinas, Angelicum) is Professor of Philosophy and Systematic Theology at Sacred Heart Major Seminary, Graduate School of Theology, in Detroit. He is the author of Roman Catholicism and Neo-Calvinism: Ecumenical and Polemical Engagements (New York: Peter Lang Publishing, 2024, forthcoming), Are We Together? A Roman Catholic Analyzes Evangelical Protestants (Lectio Publishing, 2022), Pope Francis: The Legacy of Vatican II, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded (Lectio Publishing, 2019), Revelation, History, and Truth: A Hermeneutics of Dogma (New York: Peter Lang Publishing, 2019), Divine Election: A Catholic Orientation in Dogmatic and Ecumenical Perspective (Pickwick Publications, 2016), Berkouwer and Catholicism, Disputed Questions (Brill, 2013), “In the Beginning…” A Theology of the Body (Pickwick Publications, 2011); Dialogue of Love: Confessions of an Evangelical Catholic Ecumenist (Wipf & Stock, 2010), and Slitting the Sycamore, Christ and Culture in the New Evangelization. A noted scholar, speaker, and international teacher, Professor Echeverria is also the author of dozens of articles and is a member of the American ecumenical initiative, Evangelicals and Catholics Together.
